title: Mental Wellness Articles for Calm and Clarity
intro: Short reflections and practical articles to help you slow down and think clearly.
No feed. No pressure. Just reading.

articles.title: Prevention or cure? Why timing Is everything when it comes to burnout
articles.summary: Discover why prevention becomes harder once burnout takes hold, what the research says about early intervention, and how workplaces can reduce burnout before recovery becomes necessary.

cover.alt: Badger resting at a desk, illustrating burnout prevention and recovery

articles.title: How do you know if you're actually burned out? Inside the science of measuring It
articles.summary: Explore how researchers assess burnout, why there’s no universal cutoff, and how exhaustion, cynicism, and professional efficacy can point to very different experiences and different solutions.

cover.alt: Illustration accompanying a guide to recognizing and measuring burnout

articles.title: What burnout really is and why rest alone won’t fix it
articles.summary: Explore what burnout does to your mind and body, why workplace conditions matter, and what sustainable recovery actually requires.

cover.alt: Pigeon resting at work, illustrating the effects of occupational burnout

articles.title: Body position and sleep: why how you lie down matters as much as how long
articles.summary: A guide to sleep posture, mattress support and pillow fit, explaining which positions are friendliest to the spine and offering a quick self-check for your bedroom setup

cover.alt: Illustration of healthy sleep posture and body alignment

articles.title: The sound of sleep: why silence isn't always the goal
articles.summary: An exploration of how consistent sound, not silence, supports deeper sleep, backed by research on white noise with practical alternatives and tips for handling a noisy bed partner

cover.alt: Illustration of a calm nighttime soundscape for better sleep

articles.title: Lights out: how light quietly runs your sleep schedule
articles.summary: A look at how light exposure shapes your sleep-wake cycle, backed by research on blue-light therapy with practical steps for using morning light and managing evening screens.

cover.alt: Illustration showing how morning and evening light affect sleep

articles.title: The Chemistry Behind a Good Night's Sleep
